name: Pallor Shift
body:
Prerequisite(s): deathly pallor class feature, necroknight level 9th.

Benefit(s): While you have temporary hit points granted by necrosis shroud, as a move action you may change the benefit granted by your deathly pallor class feature.

Normal: After you use necrosis shroud, you cannot change your selected deathly pallor benefit while you have temporary hit points remaining.
